present: [1.] hárati etc. V.+ hárate etc. V.+ -- [2.] harmi -- [3.] jiharti

derivatives: -hara hāra V.+ -hāraka E.+ hārin E.+ hāryà AV.+ háraṇa AV.+ -haraṇīya E.+ -hāraṇa C. háras V.+ hā́ruka B. -hṛt V.+ hṛti B.+ -hṛ́tya B. hartavya E.+ hartṛ B.+ jihīrṣā E.+ jihīrṣu E.+ -hārayitavya C. 
Apparently a variant to √bhṛ; making a very small figure in the oldest language, it gains rapidly in use, and becomes extremely common.
